Differential expression analysis using DESeq2 or limma-voom

rna_compare.Rd

Performs differential expression analysis between experimental groups using RNA-seq count data stored in the active rna_project. Supports both DESeq2 and limma (voom) frameworks.

The function handles design matrix construction, contrast specification, and result extraction, returning standardized outputs across methods.

Usage

rna_compare(
  project,
  group_col = "Group",
  batch_col = "Batch",
  method = c("deseq2", "limma"),
  contrast = NULL,
  plot = TRUE,
  save = TRUE,
  store_model = FALSE,
  verbose = TRUE
)

Arguments

project

rna_project object created by rna_project().

group_col

Character. Column name in metadata defining experimental groups (default: "Group").

batch_col

Optional character. Column specifying batch effects. If present in metadata, it is included in the design formula.

method

Character. Differential expression method: "deseq2" or "limma".

contrast

Specifies the comparison(s) to perform. Can be:

  • A character vector of length 2: c("test", "reference")

  • A list of such vectors for multiple contrasts

plot

Logical. If TRUE, displays diagnostic plots: MA plot (both methods) and dispersion plot (DESeq2 only).

save

Logical. Whether to store results in the active rna_project.

store_model

Logical. Wheter to store the complete model results in the active rna_project.

verbose

Logical. Whether to print progress messages.

Value

Returns (invisibly) either:

  • A single object of class "rnaCompare" if one contrast is specified

  • A named list of such objects if multiple contrasts are provided

Each "rnaCompare" object contains:

  • model: Fitted model object (DESeqDataSet or MArrayLM)

  • res: Data frame with differential expression results

  • contrast: Contrast specification used

  • groups: List with test and reference

  • method: Method used ("deseq2" or "limma")

  • plots: List of plotting functions (MA and dispersion)

Details

The function requires raw count data and expects that normalization has been performed with rna_normalize(method = "none") to preserve integer counts.

Contrast definition: All contrasts are defined as test − reference, which determines the sign of the log2 fold-change:

  • Positive log2FC -> higher expression in test group

  • Negative log2FC -> higher expression in reference group

Method-specific details:

  • DESeq2: Uses negative binomial GLM with dispersion estimation.

  • limma: Uses voom transformation followed by linear modeling with empirical Bayes moderation.

Multiple contrasts can be specified and will be computed independently. Each result is stored with a unique identifier in: rna_project$analyses$comparison.

Output summary

A summary is printed to the console including:

  • Total genes tested

  • Number of significant genes (adjusted p-value < 0.05)

  • Number of up- and down-regulated genes

  • Top-ranked genes

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
# Basic usage
rna_compare(my_project,
            contrast = c("treated", "control"))

# Multiple contrasts
rna_compare(my_project,
            contrast = list(
                            c("treated", "control"),
                            c("treated2", "control")
  )
)

# Using limma instead of DESeq2
rna_compare(my_project,
            contrast = c("treated", "control"),
            method = "limma")

# Including batch effect
rna_compare(my_project,
            contrast = c("treated", "control"),
            batch_col = "Batch")
} # }
